flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4175/app?demo then Click tostado-web under Repositories in the left sidebar.
Check that the heading reads Inbox tostado-web.
Check that Move cart totals into a hook is listed under Claude is fixing.
Click Inbox in the left sidebar.
Check that the heading reads just Inbox.
Check that Make the free shipping threshold easier to read is listed under Needs you.

Do each step once, the way it is described. If a click or a key press does something other than what the step expects, the check fails: don't retry it, and don't reach the goal another way (other buttons, links, keyboard shortcuts, typing the URL). Waiting for a slow page to load is fine.
